name: gameforge-agent
description: A CodeArts-powered agent workspace for end-to-end TypeScript game engineering.

scripts.build:foundation: bun run --filter @gameforge/contracts build && bun run --filter @gameforge/generator build && bun run --filter @gameforge/providers build && bun run --filter @gameforge/asset-store build && bun run --filter @gameforge/run-relay build && bun run --filter @gameforge/game-verifier build
scripts.build: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter @gameforge/game build && bun run --filter @gameforge/workbench build && bun run --filter @gameforge/tui build && bun run --filter @gameforge/opencode-plugin build && bun run --filter @gameforge/integrations build && bun run --filter @gameforge/mcp-server build
scripts.check: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter '*' check
scripts.test: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.doctor: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter @gameforge/mcp-server build && node packages/mcp-server/dist/doctor.js
scripts.provider:smoke: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter @gameforge/mcp-server build && node packages/mcp-server/dist/provider-smoke.js
